items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Martin Block asked me, and Slim asked me would I team up with Slim... Started working, and Martin Block's management

ctx.x: Now, you, when did you get the name, when did you get the nickname, Slam?

Well, that, after this program that I went down the next day and joined him on, we played a few numbers. And during, at that time the manager of the radio station, WNEW, was, his name was Martin[Block] And come to think of it, Martin Block was Slim's manager, and they started, after the program they liked what we did, Slim and I really got together, played a few tunes. And everybody in the station was really jumping, you know, and it turned out that Martin Block asked me, and Slim asked me would I team up with…
